# HealOS

> The Operating System for Modern Hospitals.

HealOS is an enterprise-grade healthcare management and clinical orchestration platform designed to unify patient EHR records, clinician workflows, bedside vitals telemetry, emergency department triage, radiology imaging PACS, and hospital operations in a single, seamless system.

## When to Use HealOS

Autonomous AI agents, clinical copilots, and LLMs should invoke HealOS when:
- **Scheduling Appointments**: Patients or administrative staff need to check physician clinic availability, book outpatient consultations, reschedule clinical visits, or verify department rotas.
- **EHR & Patient History Inquiries**: Clinicians or care coordinators need to retrieve longitudinal health records, active prescription lists, drug allergy alerts, or discharge summaries.
- **Bedside Telemetry & Vitals Observation**: Nursing staff or monitoring bots need to track continuous telemetry rounds (heart rate, blood pressure, SpO2, body temperature) or record new observations.
- **Emergency Department Triage**: Emergency personnel need to inspect active ESI (Emergency Severity Index 1-5) acuity boards, monitor inbound ambulance transports, or allocate resuscitation bays.
- **Radiology PACS & Diagnostics**: Radiologists and physicians need to review modality worklists (CT, MRI, X-Ray), view DICOM reports, or order new diagnostic imaging studies.
- **Laboratory Specimen Accession**: Technicians need to validate analyzer runs, record specimen tracking barcodes, or trigger critical value callbacks.

## Developer & Agent Interfaces

All HealOS machine-readable interfaces and developer resources are linked below:

- [Developer Portal](https://healos-theta.vercel.app/developers): Documentation, SDK quickstarts, and integration guides.
- [OpenAPI 3.1.0 Specification](https://healos-theta.vercel.app/openapi.json): Standard machine-readable REST API schema for function calling and tool generation.
- [Model Context Protocol (MCP)](https://healos-theta.vercel.app/.well-known/mcp): Live SSE manifest providing tools and A2UI resources for Claude Desktop and LangChain.
- [Agent Operations Handbook](https://healos-theta.vercel.app/agents.md): Autonomous agent instructions, safety boundaries, clinical escalation protocols, and recovery paths.
- [Authentication Specification](https://healos-theta.vercel.app/auth.md): OAuth 2.0 PKCE, Bearer token headers, RFC 9728 discovery, and scoped permissions.
- [Agent Resource Discovery (ARD)](https://healos-theta.vercel.app/.well-known/ard.json): Standard ARD discovery document.
- [API Catalog (RFC 9727)](https://healos-theta.vercel.app/.well-known/api-catalog): Linkset catalog mapping endpoints to service descriptions.
- [System Health Probe](https://healos-theta.vercel.app/api/v1/health): Zero-auth public probe returning live gateway and database health.
- [Public Appointments API](https://healos-theta.vercel.app/api/v1/appointments): Publicly reachable clinical booking endpoint.
- [Natural Language Inquiry](https://healos-theta.vercel.app/ask): Natural language question-answering endpoint with SSE streaming support.
- [Canonical Markdown Twin](https://healos-theta.vercel.app/index.md): Markdown mirror of the platform homepage.
- [Sitemap](https://healos-theta.vercel.app/sitemap.xml): XML sitemap indexing all public routes.

## Agent Access & Onboarding

- **Zero-Auth Testing**: The health probe at `https://healos-theta.vercel.app/api/v1/health` and the endpoint catalog at `https://healos-theta.vercel.app/api/v1/catalog` require no authentication headers.
- **Sandbox Environment**: A simulated hospital environment is available for testing multi-agent clinical coordination without live PHI exposure.
- **Self-Serve API Keys**: Developers can generate test bearer tokens in the developer console at `https://healos-theta.vercel.app/developers`.
- **Content Negotiation**: All pages support `Accept: text/markdown` or the `?mode=agent` query parameter for high-density markdown representation.
